_comment: Skills for USING an org tool from any repo, sourced from that tool's own repo (org skills landscape audit, decision D2). install-skills.ps1 installs them with Core: a shallow sparse clone of `path` at `ref`, then the same install as a repo skill, with a marker naming the tool repo and commit. Optional `url` overrides https://github.com/<repo>.git (tests use a local repo). bot-arena is not here: `npx skills` installs and updates it from its repo already. AI Tools Sync reads this list too, so it doesn't treat these as third-party skills.
